visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with scenic long shots of a mountain range heavily dusted with snow under a clear blue sky. Frosted pine trees dominate the foreground, their needles encased in white. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the snow and the brown alpine grass in lower elevations. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a vehicle at night. A male character wearing a black beanie, glasses, and a black jacket is seated, holding a smartphone with both hands. He is focused on the screen, his mouth slightly open as he prepares to speak. The background is dark and cluttered with car interior elements like seats and headrests. (3) A close-up view of the smartphone screen reveals the 'Windy' weather application interface, displaying a wind and temperature map over a geographic area. The man's thumb is visible as he swipes and taps on the screen to navigate between different weather forecasting models like ECMWF and Meteoblue. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the frame to accompany his demonstration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a practical guide for mountain travelers on how to use meteorological applications effectively. The creator shares his firsthand experience at Wuling, highlighting that standard models may be inaccurate at high altitudes and recommending the Meteoblue model for more precise snow and temperature predictions.
